lines: Tokiko
Evil Eye: Clairvoyant Eye!!!
With the enemy closing upon her, Tokiko softly closed both her eyes.
And as she did, a number of patterns like eyes emerged in the air around her.
It was the demonic power of the Evil Eye within her. Each one shined brightly...
Tokiko
Pandemonium!!!
Countless kunai were instantly released from the bewitching eyes floating in midair.
*Thunk thunk thunk thunk!!!*
Igawa Kunoichi
Gwaghhhh!!!
The Igawa ninja who aimed to take the life of the young head were pierced by the kunai that fell upon them like rain, and they collapsed to the ground one after the other.
Igawa Kunoichi
That's that genius they all talk about, Fuma Tokiko!!!
井河くノ一
Don't underestimate her just because she's a kid! Press her with numbers!
Tokiko
I won't let you!!
Tokiko unleashed her Pandemonium kunai again.
*Thunk thunk thunk!!*
The rain of kunai fell upon them once more.
Igawa Kunoichi
Ghaaghhh!!!
One, then two more enemies were pierced by the rain of kunai.
But that number was clearly less than the first round.
The Evil Eye is a powerful technique, therefore its use caused Tokiko a great amount of fatigue.
Moreover, she was currently outnumbered while defending Kotaro.
Tokiko
Ghnghh...
Even the genius kunoichi was starting to become lightheaded and out of breath.
The enemy perceived this and tried to overwhelm her once more with their assault.
Igawa Kunoichi
She's on her last legs!! Don't just stand there, get her!!
Tokiko
Don't underestimate Fuma Tokiko!!
Tokiko mustered all her strength.
She couldn't give up at this point.
Her defeat was synonymous with Kotaro's death.
Which of course meant the destruction of the Fuma head family as well.
However, the enemy descended upon them with wave after unrelenting wave.
Tokiko
Ghngh!
It seemed this was finally the end of the line.
In which case, she would offer the rest of her life force to the Evil Eye and annihilate the enemy, even if it was only the ones here.
Tokiko steeled her resolve for her final stand. But just as she didー
Yaguruma Yaemon
It is good to see you well, Lady Tokiko.
*Ka-booooooooom!!!*
The ground erupted violently as if a dragon had flown out of the earth.
The huge hand that had appeared, upheaving the earth and sand, firmly gripped the ankle of the Igawa kunoichi who had just been about to attack Tokiko...
Yaguruma Yaemon
Mrrrngh!!
...and with a deep cry, he lifted the kunoichi high off the ground and slammed her back down with tremendous force.
*Splaaat!!!*
The kunoichi had her gray matter splattered before she could even react.
Kotaro
Oh! Yaemon!!
Yaguruma Yaemon
GUHUHUHUHUH!! It is indeed, young lord!
The giant gave a hearty laugh and tossed the kunoichi's shattered head aside...
*Boom!! Boom!! Boom boom boom!!!*
...and at the same time, fountains of sediment began to erupt from all over.
Massively built men emerged from the ground one after the other. Each sharing the same appearance as the giant man who just overpowered the kunoichi.
Igawa Kunoichi
Wh-Who goes there? ーWaghh!
*Splat!!!*
Igawa Kunoichi
What in the world is this!? ーGwaaghh!!
*Ker-splat!!*
The Igawa ninja fell into disorder as they were easily grabbed by the giant men and crushed like insects.
Yaguruma Yaemon
GUHUHUHUHUHUH!! Weak! Weak! All too weak!!
He was Yaguruma Yaemon.
One of the Eight Generals of the Fuma and a chief retainer supporting the Nisha Clan.
He was a master of the Exelemental Ninja Art "Metaphysical Mimicry," a camouflage Jutsu.
It creates an alter ego that can combine with any inorganic substance other than water and maneuver at will.
Igawa Kunoichi
G-, get back in position!! Retreat for now andー
Yao Bikuni
Fufufu, such foolishness.
No sooner had they heard that cool laugh when suddenly...
Igawa Kunoichi
Gwaaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!!!
The Igawa Kunoichi who still remained all crumpled in pain together.
They screamed so loud they almost tore their throats asunder, and they sprawled on the ground clawing at their own bodies as if they had gone mad.
*Rip, pop, crunch crunch!!*
Strange sounds emanated from the writhing kunoichi, their bodies transforming...
Their hair fell out in clumps, their scalps ripped open, and even the skin on their faces tore and peeled back to cause their now lidless eyes to protrude outward.
And from the neck down, their epidermises rolled away in the blink of an eye, and hard skin with dense scales embedded within it emerged.
Both legs twisted, entwining and fusing together, similarly gaining scales and transforming into huge, fin-like objects.
They now had fish-like faces, scale-covered bodies, and fin-like lower halves.
They weren't mermaids, but horrific monsters that looked more like malformed fish people.
Kotaro
Whoa, Bikuni's here too!
Yao Bikuni
Aye, young lord. If thou wouldst hath patience for but a moment longer.
Yao Bikuni
I shall curse all ye foul Igawa with mine Evil Eye.
The one responsible for transforming the kunoichi into monsters was Yao Bikuni.
She was yet another chief retainer supporting the Nisha Clan.
It was said that she has served since the first Fuma Kotaro, and if true, it would mean she has lived for over 500 years.
Her Evil Eye, "Mermaid's Sapphire Eyes," was said to suck out the life energy of her opponents and transform them into deformed monsters.
Yao Bikuni
O ye worthless Igawa, ye shalt be as sustenance for Yao Bikuni.
The deformed Igawa kunoichi had their life energy drained even further by Bikuni.
Igawa Kunoichi
Gh-ghah... gh-ghah... gah-gah... gah-gagh!!!
Even the screams in their last moments were no longer those uttered by humans.
*Flop... flop... flop flop...*
Their distorted tail fins flopping awkwardly, which were probably useless in water anyway, the Igawa kunoichi spent their last.
Silence had finally returned to the shrine's grove.
Tokiko
Yaguruma Yaemon, Yao Bikuni. Thank you, we are in your debt.
Kotaro
You really came through for us, you two.
Tokiko had finally dispelled her Evil Eye, and even Kotaro had shown a smile.
Yaguruma Yaemon
Haha! Yaguruma Yaemon is here!
Yao Bikuni
Yao Bikuni doth pay her respects.
The loyal retainers who had saved Tokiko and Kotaro's lives knelt down reverently.
